title: Yantra answer page
description: A question answered on one printable page: the answer first, then typed blocks. Build with `yantra build page.json`.

question.description: The question being answered; shown as the page heading.

title.description: Short title (browser tab); shown under the question when different.

kicker.description: Small label above the heading, e.g. Explainer, Decision, How-to. Default: Question.

footer.description: Small print at the bottom left.

watermark.description: false hides the badge; a string replaces its text.

updated.description: Last revised, shown in the byline as "Updated …", e.g. 20/10/2026.

toc.description: true shows a contents row linking to every titled block; false hides it. Default: shown from 6 titled blocks.

headline.description: The conclusion in one or two sentences (under 220 characters).

text.description: A short paragraph of context. Inline markdown allowed.

points.description: 3-5 supporting points, shown as a checklist.

title.description: Section heading; also the block anchor (#slug-of-title) used by the contents row.

span.description: half puts two blocks side by side on wide screens.

items.description: points/steps: {title, text?, tone?}; metrics: {label, value, note?, tone?, trend?: [numbers] (sparkline)}; sources: {title, url?, note?}; timeline: {date, title, text?, tone?}; faq: {q, a}; checklist: {text, done?, note?}; kv: {k, v}; gantt: {title, id?, group?, start? (date or day number), end? (last day) | days?, after? (id or [ids]), milestone?, progress? (0-100), tone?}; matrix: {label, x, y, tone?}.

rows.description: table rows, one cell per column.

options.description: compare: {name, summary?, pros?, cons?, verdict?, recommended?}.

diagram.description: diagram: an inline Yantra diagram payload.

src.description: diagram: path to a diagram .json, relative to this page file. image: an https: URL or a data:image/ URI (other schemes are rejected).

caption.description: diagram, image, chart, gantt, matrix: caption under the figure.

data.description: chart: [{label, value (number), tone?}]. Without kind (or kind bar) drawn as horizontal bars; also the slices of pie and donut charts.

unit.description: chart: suffix for values, e.g. ms or %.

nodes.description: Inspector panels only: show this block only while one of these cards is selected.

source.description: quote: where it was said or written.

alt.description: image: required text alternative for screen readers.

width.description: image: maximum display width in pixels.

interactive.description: diagram: embed the full step-through viewer on screen (the static figure is printed). Keep to 2 per page.

kind.description: chart: bar (horizontal, default), column, line, area, pie or donut.

stacked.description: chart (bar, column, area with series): stack the series instead of grouping or overlapping them.

categories.description: chart: x-axis labels (or dates, YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY, spaced by time on line and area charts), one per series value.

series.description: chart: [{name, values: [number or null], tone?}], one value per category; at most 6 series.

start.description: gantt: the plan's first day (YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY); numeric task starts count days from it.

today.description: gantt: draw a 'today' line on this date (or day number).

grid.description: matrix: 2 for a 2x2 quadrant (items placed by score), 3-5 for a heat map (items listed in cells).

x.description: matrix: horizontal axis, a label or {label, low?, high?, labels? (one per column, heat maps), min?, max?}. Default range 0-10 (2x2) or 1-grid.

y.description: matrix: vertical axis (counted upwards), as for x.

quadrants.description: matrix (grid 2): 4 titles or {title, tone?}: top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right.

heat.description: matrix (grid 3-5): colour cells low to high by row x column; false keeps them plain.

level.description: diagram: show this detail diagram (an id in the diagram's diagrams map) instead of its overview; an interactive viewer opens there and can go back up.
